name: SalesCallOutcomePicker
tagline: The Sales Call Outcome Picker is the field a rep fills in straight after a sales call.
description: The Sales Call Outcome Picker is the field a rep fills in straight after a sales call. Instead of a plain dropdown, it shows the possible outcomes as large options in two groups - Connected and Not reached - and immediately tells the rep what happens next: when to follow up, how many attempts have been made, and whether a call note is needed.
